  method={"get"}
  path={"/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cycles/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Microservices-only AutoPay subscription-management proxy. Connect terminates merchant authentication using private API key, Basic auth, or Keycloak JWT, resolves the merchant tenant, forwards the request to AutoPay with Merchant-Id, and returns AutoPay's response body and status to the merchant.

Returns AutoPay billing-cycle history, including nested payment attempts and pagination.

<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cycles/?limit={limit}&offset={offset}' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY'"}</pre>
